# admin_disabled
# admin routes with --allow-admin off, the default
# normalized: none

HTTP 403
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":{"message":"admin API disabled (start serve with --allow-admin)","type":"invalid_request_error"}}

GET /admin/generations


HTTP 403
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":{"message":"admin API disabled (start serve with --allow-admin)","type":"invalid_request_error"}}
